question: How many courses are there? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM crs_mst

question: How many instructors are there? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM instr_mst

question: How many departments are there? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dept_mst

question: How many classes have been cancelled? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cls_mst WHERE cls_sts = 'cancelled'

question: How many class sessions were held? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cls_sess WHERE sess_sts = 'held'

question: What is the highest final score on record? Return only the score.
gold_sql: SELECT max(final_score) FROM grade

question: How many invoices are unpaid? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoice WHERE inv_sts = 'unpaid'

question: What is the total amount of payments made by card? Return only the total.
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment WHERE method = 'card'

question: How many grades of A have been given? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM grade WHERE letter = 'A'

question: What is the average class capacity? Return only the average.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(capacity) FROM cls_mst

question: How many classes does each department's courses have? Return the department code and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.dept_cd, count(*) FROM cls_mst k JOIN crs_mst c ON c.crs_id = k.crs_id GROUP BY c.dept_cd

question: How many enrollments does each course have? Return the course code and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.crs_code, count(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id JOIN crs_mst c ON c.crs_id = k.crs_id GROUP BY c.crs_code

question: How many classes does each instructor teach? Return the instructor id and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT i.instr_id, count(*) FROM instr_mst i JOIN cls_instr ci ON ci.instr_id = i.instr_id GROUP BY i.instr_id

question: What is the average final score in each term? Return the term code and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT t.term_cd, avg(g.final_score) FROM grade g JOIN enrollment e ON e.enr_id = g.enr_id JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id JOIN term_mst t ON t.term_id = k.term_id GROUP BY t.term_cd

question: What is the total invoiced amount per term? Return the term code and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT t.term_cd, sum(i.amount) FROM invoice i JOIN term_mst t ON t.term_id = i.term_id GROUP BY t.term_cd

question: How many submissions does each class have? Return the class id and the count, only for classes with at least one submission.
gold_sql: SELECT a.cls_id, count(*) FROM submission s JOIN assignment a ON a.asg_id = s.asg_id GROUP BY a.cls_id

question: How many attendance records does each department's courses have? Return the department code and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.dept_cd, count(*) FROM attendance a JOIN cls_sess s ON s.sess_id = a.sess_id JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = s.cls_id JOIN crs_mst c ON c.crs_id = k.crs_id GROUP BY c.dept_cd

question: For each instructor department, how many classes are taught by its instructors? Return the department code and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT i.dept_cd, count(*) FROM cls_instr ci JOIN instr_mst i ON i.instr_id = ci.instr_id GROUP BY i.dept_cd

question: How many students received a grade of F in each course? Return the course code and the count, only for courses with at least one.
gold_sql: SELECT c.crs_code, count(*) FROM grade g JOIN enrollment e ON e.enr_id = g.enr_id JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id JOIN crs_mst c ON c.crs_id = k.crs_id WHERE g.letter = 'F' GROUP BY c.crs_code

question: What is the average submission score per department of the course? Return the department code and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT c.dept_cd, avg(s.score) FROM submission s JOIN assignment a ON a.asg_id = s.asg_id JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = a.cls_id JOIN crs_mst c ON c.crs_id = k.crs_id GROUP BY c.dept_cd

question: What is the overall attendance rate, as present records divided by all attendance records? Return only the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE att_sts = 'present')::numeric / count(*) FROM attendance

question: What is the attendance rate per class, as present records divided by all attendance records? Return the class id and the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT s.cls_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.att_sts = 'present')::numeric / count(*) FROM attendance a JOIN cls_sess s ON s.sess_id = a.sess_id GROUP BY s.cls_id

question: What is the total outstanding tuition, meaning the amount on unpaid invoices? Return only the total.
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM invoice WHERE inv_sts = 'unpaid'

question: What is the drop rate, as dropped enrollments divided by all enrollments? Return only the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE enr_sts = 'dropped')::numeric / count(*) FROM enrollment

question: What is the session cancellation rate, as cancelled sessions divided by all sessions? Return only the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sess_sts = 'cancelled')::numeric / count(*) FROM cls_sess

question: What is the pass rate, as grades other than F divided by all grades? Return only the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE letter <> 'F')::numeric / count(*) FROM grade

question: What is the average class fill rate, as enrollments in a class divided by its capacity, across classes with at least one enrollment? Return only the average.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(n::numeric / capacity) FROM (SELECT k.cls_id, k.capacity, count(*) AS n FROM enrollment e JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id GROUP BY k.cls_id, k.capacity) x

question: What is the void invoice rate per term, as void invoices divided by all invoices? Return the term id and the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT term_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE inv_sts = 'void')::numeric / count(*) FROM invoice GROUP BY term_id

question: What is the average score as a share of maximum points across submissions? Return only the average fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(s.score / a.max_pts) FROM submission s JOIN assignment a ON a.asg_id = s.asg_id

question: What is the average total billed per student, across students who have at least one invoice? Return only the average.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(t) FROM (SELECT std_id, sum(amount) AS t FROM invoice GROUP BY std_id) x

question: How many students enrolled in 2024? Count enrollments by when the student enrolled. Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE enrolled_at >= '2024-01-01' AND enrolled_at < '2025-01-01'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

question: How many enrollments happened in March 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE enrolled_at >= '2024-03-01' AND enrolled_at < '2024-04-01'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE created_at >= '2024-03-01' AND created_at < '2024-04-01'

question: How many enrollment records were entered into the system in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE enrolled_at >= '2024-01-01' AND enrolled_at < '2025-01-01'

question: How many classes started in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cls_mst WHERE start_date >= '2024-01-01' AND start_date < '2025-01-01'

question: How many students joined the system in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

question: For each month of 2024, how many students enrolled? Use the enrollment date, and return the month number and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT extract(month FROM enrolled_at)::int, count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE enrolled_at >= '2024-01-01' AND enrolled_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT extract(month FROM created_at)::int, count(*) FROM enrollment WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many invoices were issued in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoice WHERE issued_dt >= '2024-01-01' AND issued_dt < '2025-01-01'

question: What was the total of payments received in 2024? Return only the total.
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment WHERE paid_dt >= '2024-01-01' AND paid_dt < '2025-01-01'

question: How many assignments were due in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM assignment WHERE due_dt >= '2024-01-01' AND due_dt < '2025-01-01'

question: How many enrollments happened in classes that started in 2024, by when the student enrolled being in 2024 too? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id WHERE k.start_date >= '2024-01-01' AND k.start_date < '2025-01-01' AND e.enrolled_at >= '2024-01-01' AND e.enrolled_at < '2025-01-01'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN cls_mst k ON k.cls_id = e.cls_id WHERE k.start_date >= '2024-01-01' AND k.start_date < '2025-01-01' AND e.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND e.created_at < '2025-01-01'

question: How many students do we have? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst WHERE rec_sts = 'active'

question: How many students does each department have? Return the department code and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT dept_cd, count(*) FROM std_mst WHERE rec_sts = 'active' GROUP BY dept_cd
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT dept_cd, count(*) FROM std_mst GROUP BY dept_cd

question: How many students joined in 2024? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst WHERE rec_sts = 'active' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

question: How many enrollments belong to current students? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = e.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'

question: What is the total invoiced to current students? Return only the total.
gold_sql: SELECT sum(i.amount) FROM invoice i JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = i.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'

question: How many students have at least one enrollment? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.std_id) FROM std_mst s JOIN enrollment e ON e.std_id = s.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'

question: How many students have never enrolled? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst s WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment e WHERE e.std_id = s.std_id)
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(*) FROM std_mst s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment e WHERE e.std_id = s.std_id)

question: What is the attendance rate of current students, as present records divided by all their records? Return only the fraction.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.att_sts = 'present')::numeric / count(*) FROM attendance a JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = a.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'

question: How many current students have an unpaid invoice? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.std_id) FROM std_mst s JOIN invoice i ON i.std_id = s.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active' AND i.inv_sts = 'unpaid'
wrong_sql_variants: SELECT count(DISTINCT std_id) FROM invoice WHERE inv_sts = 'unpaid'

question: How many submissions came from current students? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submission x JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = x.std_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'

question: How many payments can be matched to an invoice? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code

question: What is the total paid per invoice status? Return the invoice status and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT i.inv_sts, sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code GROUP BY i.inv_sts

question: What is the total paid per term? Return the term id and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT i.term_id, sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code GROUP BY i.term_id

question: How many payments were made against void invoices? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code WHERE i.inv_sts = 'void'

question: How many invoices have received at least one payment? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.inv_id) FROM invoice i JOIN payment p ON p.ref_code = i.code

question: How many invoices have received no payment? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoice i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.ref_code = i.code)

question: What is the total paid per student department? Return the department code and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT s.dept_cd, sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = i.std_id GROUP BY s.dept_cd

question: What is the total paid by each payment method on paid invoices? Return the method and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT p.method, sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code WHERE i.inv_sts = 'paid' GROUP BY p.method

question: What is the average payment on unpaid invoices? Return only the average.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code WHERE i.inv_sts = 'unpaid'

question: How many distinct students have made a payment? Return only the count.
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.std_id) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i ON i.code = p.ref_code
